_comment: The functions-only site of docs/ACCOUNTS-PLAN.md §2, §13.1, §13.8 (D19). Host-neutral description used by server/site/build.js and checked by the tests; the owner maps it to the host's own settings once (server/RUNBOOK.md, Activation checklist). It lives in server/ on purpose: the repository root carries no host configuration, so the static site keeps deploying exactly as v3.4. v4.0: the site runs on Netlify — server/netlify.toml (base directory server), netlify/functions/*.mjs (site/netlify.js FUNCTIONS) and the 'netlify' block below; the generic entry/ stays for any other host.
name: wts-accounts-api

schedules.name: ops-daily
schedules.how: POST /api/v1/ops/daily signed with WTS_OPS_HMAC (server/ops/call-daily.js) — or the host scheduler invoking the same

schedules.name: weekly-export
schedules.how: node server/ops/weekly-export.js (jobs host or the owner's machine; never from the static site)

rewrite._comment: Configured on the MAIN site by the owner: a netlify.toml [[redirects]] rule from `node server/site/proxy-rule.js --snippet <functions-site>.netlify.app`, the signature filled in at build time from the main site's WTS_PROXY_SIG (never committed).

addRequestHeaders.X-WTS-Proxy-Sig: <WTS_PROXY_SIG — filled in by server/site/proxy-rule.js --apply at the main site build>

netlify.functionsRegion: lhr (London; pinned in every function's own config and set as the site setting before the database is created; credit-based Pro plan)
netlify.database: Netlify Database (NETLIFY_DB_URL, one login; request transactions SET LOCAL ROLE wts_api, jobs wts_jobs, export wts_backup)
netlify.builds: stopped (releases from server-v* tags with the CLI: RUNBOOK)

netlifyLive._comment: Same-site mode on the LIVE site (owner decision 2026-11-09, RUNBOOK §3L): the API functions run on welltest.h2oil.co.uk itself (WTS_SITE_MODE=same; no proxy rule, no signature). Built by `node server/site/build-live.js --out <dir>` and uploaded as one folder.
netlifyLive.functionsRegion: the site's default functions region (no pin; next to the database)
netlifyLive.database: Netlify Database in the platform's default region (United States, Ohio) — permanent
